findings.why_it_matters: The optional-modules half of the module diagram is split into a separate table with no subset rows, so the vertical placement of each optional module level against the HIGH / INTERMEDIATE / MINIMUM subsets (RPW and ITR spanning all three, level 2 COM/DEB/SEG upper, level 1 lower) is lost. The module levels and their 0,1 / 0,2 ranges are all preserved; only the drawn alignment is gone.
